title: Rotate
text: Rotate image by specified angle, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Interpolation method} sets Interpolation method; {Output size} sets the size of rotated image Expanded to fit rotated input, {Rotation angle source}, {Angle (radians)} sets the rotation angle, {Maximum angle (enter pi radians to accommodate all positive and negative angles)} sets the maximum angle, {Display rotated image in} sets the position of output image, {Sine value computation method}, {Background fill value}, {Angle values} sets the fixed-point parameter for angle values Same word length and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output size
params.values: Size of rotated image Expanded to fit rotated input image (default) | Same as input image

params.name: Rotation angle source
params.values: Rotation angle source Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Maximum angle (enter pi radians to accommodate all positive and negative angles)
params.values: Maximum angle of rotation pi (default) | nonnegative scalar less than or equal to pi

params.name: Display rotated image in
params.values: Position of output image Top-left corner (default) | Center

params.name: Sine value computation method
params.values: Sine value computation method Table lookup (default) | Trigonometric function

params.name: Background fill value
params.values: Background fill value numeric scalar | three-element numeric vector

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Interpolation method Bilinear (default) | Nearest neighbor | Bicubic

params.name: Angle values
params.values: Fixed-point parameter for angle values Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
